c74object.name: mc.evi.listgen
c74object.digest: Create message lists with mcwrapper features
c74object.description: Create message lists with mcwrapper features - a patch idea by Todd Ingalls - THANKS!

inlet.digest: # chans (same as @chans) / (bang) output previous list / (anything) any mcwrapper method

method.name: int
method.digest: In left inlet, int message to 'mc.evi.listgen'
method.description: An integer in the left inlet will set the number of mc channels directly.

method.name: bang
method.digest: In left inlet, bang message to 'mc.evi.listgen'
method.description: A bang in the left inlet will output the previously generated list.

method.name: clear
method.digest: In left inlet, clear message to 'mc.evi.listgen'
method.description: The word 'clear' will clear the internal stored list.

method.name: anything
method.description: Any mcwrapper feature in the left inlet will create an output list with those elements, such as deviate, increment, exponential, etc.

attribute.name: chans
attribute.description: mc.evi.listgen does not auto adapt to the number of mc channels. Channel count must be set via the @chans attribute exactly. This equates to the number of items in the generated list output.
